summary: Backend v3 API endpoints tested post-refactoring (Phase 2). All 72 tests passed - no regressions after extracting CachedBoardBuilderService, OddsApiService, TierBuilderService, and ParlayBuilderService from demon_goblin_engine.py.

GET /api/v3/status.details: Returns sync status with correct counts (unique_players, total_props, standard/demons/goblins)

GET /api/v3/war-zone.details: Returns 10 demon picks with 4-Pillar scoring (pillar_1_ceiling, pillar_2_vegas, pillar_3_dvp, pillar_4_context), heat_level, DVP info

GET /api/v3/goblin-vault.details: Returns 10 safe goblin picks with vault_score, safety_level, value_gap metrics

GET /api/v3/front-lines.details: Returns 10 mixed tier picks with frontlines_score, bullet_level, demon_count/goblin_count

GET /api/v3/parlay-builder.details: Returns parlay tickets (2-6 picks) with correct structure, payout calculation, combined probability, 2-Team Rule compliance

cross_service_consistency.details: Status counts match tier endpoint data, tier endpoints share sync time

service_delegation.details: TierBuilderService generates heat_level/safety_level, ParlayBuilderService calculates payouts

data_integrity.details: Player names valid, stat_types valid, hit_rates in range, lines positive

new_services_created: CachedBoardBuilderService (522 lines) - Board building and player data aggregation
OddsApiService (328 lines) - Odds API interactions and prop extraction
TierBuilderService (855 lines) - Tier-based pick scoring (War Zone, Safe Haven, Front Lines)
